description.text:
The promos of the Pokémon Players Club, which replaced the Pokémon Fan Club in January 2003: 32 cards, 001/PLAY to 032/PLAY, released from January 2003 to January 2006, with the club's logo as their symbol. Members earned experience points (EXP) at weekly sessions, much like the Pokémon League outside Japan, and reached cards at set totals; each season's subscription brought cards too, starting with Regice ex, Regirock ex and Registeel ex.

From the third season, in January 2005, EXP targets became levels from Lv.1 to Lv.10, and the top prizes were the Shiny Eeveelutions, from Vaporeon at 10,000 EXP to Umbreon at 70,000, a run known as very hard to complete. Members who reached Lv.7 became "ex-Members", with exclusive club goods and preferential entry into qualifiers for the World Championships. Pokémon Card Fan and Master Ball came from Battle Road Summer 2003 and Spring 2004.
